sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Cambridge English, IELTS 10, published by Cambridge University Press and Cambridge English Language Assessment, 2015.
sentences.translation: 剑桥英语,《剑桥雅思》第 10 册,由剑桥大学出版社与剑桥英语语言测评于 2015 年出版。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: This recording is copyright.
sentences.translation: 本录音受版权保护。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: CD1.
sentences.translation: 光盘 1。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Test 1.
sentences.translation: Test 1。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You will hear a number of different recordings, and you will have to answer questions on what you hear.
sentences.translation: 你将听到若干段不同的录音,并需根据所听内容回答问题。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: There will be time for you to read the instructions and questions, and you will have a chance to check your work.
sentences.translation: 你将有时间阅读说明与题目,并有机会检查自己的答案。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: All the recordings will be played once only.
sentences.translation: 所有录音均只播放一遍。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: The test is in four sections.
sentences.translation: 本考试共四个部分。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: At the end of the test, you will be given ten minutes to transfer your answers to an answer sheet.
sentences.translation: 考试结束时,你将有十分钟把答案誊写到答题纸上。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Now turn to section 1.
sentences.translation: 现在请翻到 Section 1。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Section 1.
sentences.translation: Section 1。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You will hear a telephone conversation between a travel agent and a customer.
sentences.translation: 你将听到一段旅行社与顾客之间的电话对话。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: First, you have some time to look at questions 1 to 6.
sentences.translation: 首先,你有一些时间查看第 1 至 6 题。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You will see that there is an example that has been done for you.
sentences.translation: 你会看到有一个已经做好的示例。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: On this occasion only, the conversation relating to this will be played first.
sentences.translation: 仅此一次,与示例相关的对话会先播放一遍。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Good morning.
sentences.translation: 早上好。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: World Tours.
sentences.translation: World Tours。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: My name is Jamie.
sentences.translation: 我叫 Jamie。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: How can I help you?
sentences.translation: 有什么可以帮您的?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Good morning.
sentences.translation: 早上好。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA.
sentences.translation: 我想了解一些美国自驾游的信息。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Could you send me a brochure?
sentences.translation: 能给我寄一份宣传册吗?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Of course.
sentences.translation: 当然可以。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Could I have your name please?
sentences.translation: 请问您贵姓?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Andrea Brown.
sentences.translation: Andrea Brown。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: The customer's name is Andrea Brown, so Brown has been written in the space.
sentences.translation: 顾客的姓是 Brown,所以答案栏里已写上 Brown。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Now we shall begin.
sentences.translation: 现在我们开始。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You should answer the questions as you listen because you will not hear the recording a second time.
sentences.translation: 请边听边答题,因为录音不会再放第二遍。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Listen carefully and answer questions 1 to 6.
sentences.translation: 请仔细听,并回答第 1 至 6 题。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Good morning.
sentences.translation: 早上好。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: World Tours.
sentences.translation: World Tours。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: My name is Jamie.
sentences.translation: 我叫 Jamie。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: How can I help you?
sentences.translation: 有什么可以帮您的?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Good morning.
sentences.translation: 早上好。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I want some information on self-drive tours in the USA.
sentences.translation: 我想了解一些美国自驾游的信息。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Could you send me a brochure?
sentences.translation: 能给我寄一份宣传册吗?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Of course.
sentences.translation: 当然可以。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Could I have your name please?
sentences.translation: 请问您贵姓?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Andrea Brown.
sentences.translation: Andrea Brown。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Thank you.
sentences.translation: 谢谢。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: And your address?
sentences.translation: 您的地址呢?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: 24, Ardleigh Road.
sentences.translation: Ardleigh 路 24 号。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Can you spell that?
sentences.translation: 能拼一下吗?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: A-R-D-L-E-I-G-H Road.
sentences.translation: A-R-D-L-E-I-G-H 路。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Postcode?
sentences.translation: 邮编呢?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: BH5 2OP.
sentences.translation: BH5 2OP。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Thanks.
sentences.translation: 谢谢。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: And can I have your phone number?
sentences.translation: 能留一下电话号码吗?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Is a mobile alright?
sentences.translation: 手机可以吗?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Fine.
sentences.translation: 可以。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Thank you.
sentences.translation: 谢谢。能问一下您是从哪里知道 World Tours 的吗?朋友介绍?还是在哪里看到广告?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: And can I ask you where you heard about World Tours?
sentences.translation: 谢谢。能问一下您是从哪里知道 World Tours 的吗?朋友介绍?还是在哪里看到广告?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: From a friend?
sentences.translation: 谢谢。能问一下您是从哪里知道 World Tours 的吗?朋友介绍?还是在哪里看到广告?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Or did you see an advert somewhere?
sentences.translation: 谢谢。能问一下您是从哪里知道 World Tours 的吗?朋友介绍?还是在哪里看到广告?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: No, I read about you in the newspaper.
sentences.translation: 都不是,我是在报纸上看到你们的。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: OK, I'll get the brochures in the post to you but can I give you some information over the phone.
sentences.translation: 好的,我会把宣传册邮寄给您,不过我也可以先在电话里给您介绍一些信息。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: What kinds of things do you want to do on your holiday?
sentences.translation: 您这次假期想做什么?

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I'm interested in going to California with my family.
sentences.translation: 我想和家人去加利福尼亚。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I've got two children and we want to hire a car.
sentences.translation: 我有两个孩子,我们想租一辆车。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: OK.
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: We have a couple of self-drive tours there visiting different places of interest in California.
sentences.translation: 我们那儿有几条自驾游线路,可以游览加州不同的景点。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: The first one begins in Los Angeles and there's plenty of time to visit some of the theme parks there.
sentences.translation: 第一条从洛杉矶开始,有充足时间去逛那里的一些主题公园。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: That's something on my children's list so I'd want to include that.
sentences.translation: 那正好在孩子们的愿望清单上,所以我想把这一项包括进去。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Good.
sentences.translation: 很好。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Then you drive to San Francisco.
sentences.translation: 然后你们开车去旧金山。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: From San Francisco you can drive to Yosemite Park where you spend a couple of nights.
sentences.translation: 从旧金山可以开到优胜美地公园,在那儿住两晚。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: You can choose to stay in a lodge or on the campsite.
sentences.translation: 可以选择住小旅馆,也可以住营地。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I don't like the idea of staying in a tent.
sentences.translation: 我不想住帐篷,会太热了。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: It'd be too hot.
sentences.translation: 我不想住帐篷,会太热了。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Right.
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: And the tour ends in Las Vegas.
sentences.translation: 这条线路的终点是拉斯维加斯。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: OK.
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: The other trip we can arrange is slightly different.
sentences.translation: 我们还能安排的另一条线路略有不同。从旧金山出发,然后向南开到 Cambria。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: It starts in San Francisco.
sentences.translation: 我们还能安排的另一条线路略有不同。从旧金山出发,然后向南开到 Cambria。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Then you drive south to Cambria.
sentences.translation: 我们还能安排的另一条线路略有不同。从旧金山出发,然后向南开到 Cambria。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Someone told me there's a really nice castle near Cambria.
sentences.translation: 有人跟我说 Cambria 附近有一座很漂亮的城堡。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Will we go near that?
sentences.translation: 我们会路过吗?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Hearst Castle is on that road so you could stop there.
sentences.translation: 赫斯特城堡就在那条路上,你们可以在那儿停一下。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Good.
sentences.translation: 太好了,我想去看看。这条线路也会进沙漠吗?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I'd like to do that.
sentences.translation: 太好了,我想去看看。这条线路也会进沙漠吗?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Does this trip also go into the desert?
sentences.translation: 太好了,我想去看看。这条线路也会进沙漠吗?
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: No, it continues to Santa Monica where most people like to stop and do some shopping.
sentences.translation: 不会,接下来是去圣莫尼卡,多数人喜欢在那儿停下来逛逛街。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: We have enough of that at home so that doesn't interest us.
sentences.translation: 我们在家已经逛够了,所以对此不感兴趣。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: OK.
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Well you could go straight on to San Diego.
sentences.translation: 那你们可以直接继续往圣迭戈开。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: That's good for beaches isn't it?
sentences.translation: 那儿海滩不错,对吧?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: That's right, that's a good place to relax and your children might like to visit the zoo before flying home.
sentences.translation: 对,那儿很适合放松,孩子们在飞回家之前或许还想去动物园看看。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I don't think so.
sentences.translation: 我想不用了。我们想留点时间晒太阳、游泳。(后半句进入第 7–10 题区间,见下。)
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: We want some time for sunbathing and swimming.
sentences.translation: 我想不用了。我们想留点时间晒太阳、游泳。(后半句进入第 7–10 题区间,见下。)
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Before you hear the rest of the conversation, you have some time to look at questions 7 to 10.
sentences.translation: 在听对话剩余部分之前,你有一些时间查看第 7 至 10 题。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Now listen and answer questions 7 to 10.
sentences.translation: 现在请听录音,并回答第 7 至 10 题。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: So how many days are the trips and how much do they cost?
sentences.translation: 那这些行程分别几天、多少钱呢?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: The first one I told you about is a self-drive tour through California which lasts twelve days and covers 2,020 kilometres.
sentences.translation: 我刚才说的第一条是穿越加州的自驾游,全程十二天,总里程 2,020 公里。最短的一段是 206 公里,最长的一段是 632 公里。费用是每人 525 英镑,包含住宿、租车和机票,但不含餐食。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: The shortest journey is 206 km and the longest is 632 kilometres.
sentences.translation: 我刚才说的第一条是穿越加州的自驾游,全程十二天,总里程 2,020 公里。最短的一段是 206 公里,最长的一段是 632 公里。费用是每人 525 英镑,包含住宿、租车和机票,但不含餐食。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: The cost is £525 per person.
sentences.translation: 我刚才说的第一条是穿越加州的自驾游,全程十二天,总里程 2,020 公里。最短的一段是 206 公里,最长的一段是 632 公里。费用是每人 525 英镑,包含住宿、租车和机票,但不含餐食。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: That includes accommodation, car rental and a flight but no meals.
sentences.translation: 我刚才说的第一条是穿越加州的自驾游,全程十二天,总里程 2,020 公里。最短的一段是 206 公里,最长的一段是 632 公里。费用是每人 525 英镑,包含住宿、租车和机票,但不含餐食。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: OK.
sentences.translation: 好的。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: And the other trip?
sentences.translation: 另一条呢?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: That lasts nine days but you spend only three days on the road.
sentences.translation: 那条是九天,但真正在路上开的只有三天。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: You cover about 980 kilometres altogether.
sentences.translation: 总共大约 980 公里。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: So is that cheaper then?
sentences.translation: 那会便宜一些吗?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Yes, it's almost a hundred pounds cheaper.
sentences.translation: 是的,差不多便宜一百英镑。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: It's £429 per person, which is a good deal.
sentences.translation: 每人 429 英镑,很划算。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: So that covers accommodation and car hire.
sentences.translation: 那就是包含住宿和租车。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: What about flights?
sentences.translation: 机票呢?

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: They aren't included.
sentences.translation: 机票不含。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: But these hotels offer dinner in the price.
sentences.translation: 不过这些酒店的房价里含晚餐。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: OK.
sentences.translation: 好的,非常感谢。等我有机会看完宣传册后再跟您联系。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Well, thank you very much.
sentences.translation: 好的,非常感谢。等我有机会看完宣传册后再跟您联系。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: I'll be in touch when I've had a chance to look at the brochure.
sentences.translation: 好的,非常感谢。等我有机会看完宣传册后再跟您联系。
sentences.translationContext: 同一说话轮的完整译文

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: I'm pleased to help.
sentences.translation: 很高兴能帮到您。

sentences.speaker: TRAVEL AGENT
sentences.sentence: Goodbye.
sentences.translation: 再见。

sentences.speaker: ANDREA
sentences.sentence: Goodbye.
sentences.translation: 再见。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: That is the end of section 1.
sentences.translation: Section 1 到此结束。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.translation: 现在你有半分钟检查答案。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Section 2.
sentences.translation: Section 2。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You will hear a fitness manager of a leisure club talking to some new members.
sentences.translation: 你将听到一位休闲健身会所的健身经理在对新会员讲话。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: First, you have some time to look at questions 11 and 12.
sentences.translation: 首先,你有一些时间查看第 11 和第 12 题。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Now listen and answer questions 11 and 12.
sentences.translation: 现在请听录音,并回答第 11 和第 12 题。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: On behalf of LP Clubs, I'd like to welcome you all here today.
sentences.translation: 我代表 LP Clubs,欢迎大家今天来到这里。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: My name's Sandy Fisher and I'm one of the fitness managers here.
sentences.translation: 我叫 Sandy Fisher,是这里的健身经理之一。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Before we start our tour of the club I'll just run through some basic information about the facilities we have here, including recent improvements, and explain the types of membership available.
sentences.translation: 在开始参观会所之前,我先简要介绍一下我们这里的设施——包括最近的改善——以及可选的会员类型。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Our greatest asset is probably our swimming pool which at 25 metres isn't Olympic-sized, but now we've expanded it to eight lanes, it's much wider.
sentences.translation: 我们最大的优势大概是游泳池:25 米虽不是奥运规格,但现在已扩到八条泳道,宽多了。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: This means there are rarely more than a couple of people at a time in each lane.
sentences.translation: 这意味着每条泳道里很少会同时超过一两个人。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Unfortunately, there isn't space for an outdoor pool here but the glass roof on the swimming pool is partly retractable, which means you can enjoy something of the open-air experience on warmer days.
sentences.translation: 遗憾的是这里没有空间建室外泳池,但泳池的玻璃屋顶可以部分开合,天气暖和时你仍能感受到一些露天的体验。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Our recently refurbished fitness suite has all the latest exercise equipment including ten new running machines, and a wide range of weight-training machines.
sentences.translation: 我们最近翻新过的健身区配备了最新的运动器械,包括十台新跑步机,以及多种力量训练器械。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Each member is given full training in how to operate the equipment and there is always a trainer on duty to offer help and advice.
sentences.translation: 每位会员都会接受关于如何操作器械的完整培训,而且始终有教练值班提供帮助和建议。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Although we do have adult-only times after 6 and at certain times at weekends, children are well catered for.
sentences.translation: 虽然我们在晚上 6 点之后以及周末某些时段有仅限成人的时段,但儿童也得到很好的安排。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Older children continue to benefit from a wide range of tuition; anything from trampolining to yoga.
sentences.translation: 大一些的孩子仍可继续参加多种课程,从蹦床到瑜伽都有。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Before you hear the rest of the talk, you have some time to look at questions 13 to 20.
sentences.translation: 在听讲座剩余部分之前,你有一些时间查看第 13 至 20 题。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: Now listen and answer questions 13 to 20.
sentences.translation: 现在请听录音,并回答第 13 至 20 题。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: One thing all our members appreciate about us is that we take very good care of them.
sentences.translation: 所有会员对我们最欣赏的一点是:我们非常关心他们。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: This starts on day one with your personal assessment.
sentences.translation: 这一点从第一天的个人评估就开始了。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: You are asked to fill in a questionnaire giving details of any health problems.
sentences.translation: 你会被要求填写一份问卷,说明是否有任何健康问题。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: One of our personal trainers will then go through this with you.
sentences.translation: 随后会有一位私人教练和你一起过一遍这份问卷。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: The trainer will then take you through the safety rules for using the equipment in the fitness suite.
sentences.translation: 然后教练会向你讲解在健身区使用器械的安全规则。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: During your next exercise session a personal trainer will work with you to make sure you understand these.
sentences.translation: 在你下一次锻炼时,私人教练会和你一起练习,确保你真正理解这些规则。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: It's very important to do this because we really do want to avoid having any sports injuries.
sentences.translation: 这一点非常重要,因为我们真心希望避免任何运动伤害。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: There's a lot more to looking after yourself than simply lifting weights!
sentences.translation: 照顾好自己远不止是简单地举重!

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: At the end of the personal assessment, the trainer will draw up a plan, outlining what you should try to achieve within a six-week period.
sentences.translation: 个人评估结束时,教练会制定一份计划,列出你在六周内应努力达成的目标。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: This will then be reviewed at the end of the six weeks.
sentences.translation: 这份计划会在六周结束时再复查。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Now, I'll just quickly run through the types of membership we have available.
sentences.translation: 现在我快速介绍一下我们现有的会员类型。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: All members must pay a joining fee of £90 in addition to the rates for the monthly membership fees.
sentences.translation: 所有会员除了按月缴纳会费外,还必须支付 90 英镑的入会费。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Gold membership entitles you to free entry at all LP Clubs.
sentences.translation: 金牌会员可在所有 LP Clubs 免费入场。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: There are now LP clubs in all major cities and towns so if you travel a lot this will be a great advantage.
sentences.translation: 现在各大城市和城镇都有 LP 会所,所以如果你经常出差或旅行,这会是很大的优势。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Individual gold membership costs £50 a month and joint membership for you and your partner will cost £75.
sentences.translation: 个人金牌会员每月 50 英镑;你和伴侣的联名会员是每月 75 英镑。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Premier membership is for professional people whose work commitments make it difficult for them to use the club during the day and so LP gives booking preferences to Premier members at peak times.
sentences.translation: 尊享会员面向因工作繁忙而难以在白天使用会所的职场人士,因此 LP 在高峰时段给予尊享会员优先预约权。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: This means you will find it easier to book the sessions at times that suit you.
sentences.translation: 这意味着你会更容易约到适合自己时间的课程/时段。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Reciprocal arrangements with other LP Clubs are available to Premier members.
sentences.translation: 尊享会员也可享受与其他 LP Clubs 的互通安排。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: Premier membership is for individuals only, but you will be sent passes for guests every month.
sentences.translation: 尊享会员仅限个人,但每月会给你寄来宾客通行券。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: The monthly fee is £65.
sentences.translation: 月费是 65 英镑。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: You don't have to have any special clothes or equipment when you visit the club.
sentences.translation: 来会所时你不必自备特殊服装或装备。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: We provide robes and hairdryers in the changing rooms, but it's very important to remember your photo card because you won't be able to get in without it.
sentences.translation: 更衣室提供浴袍和吹风机,但一定要记得带会员照片卡——没有它你进不去。

sentences.speaker: SANDY
sentences.sentence: For people who aren't working during the day then ...
sentences.translation: 对于白天不上班的人,那么......(录音在此处被考试说明打断/截断)

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: That is the end of section 2.
sentences.translation: Section 2 到此结束。

sentences.speaker: ANNOUNCER
sentences.sentence: You now have half a minute to check your answers.
sentences.translation: 现在你有半分钟检查答案。
